displayedInputs.question: How should expressions with parentheses be evaluated?

choices.A: First calculate what is inside the parentheses
choices.B: Calculate addition and subtraction before evaluating the parentheses

displayedInputs.question: There are 3 boxes of pens, with 12 pens per box, and another 6 pens are taken out. How many pens are there in total? Calculate: \(12\times3+6=?\)
When calculating \(46+98\), you can first calculate \(46+100\) and then subtract 2. What is \(46+100\)? Calculate: \(46+100=?\)
There are 25 people in each row and 4 rows. How many people are there in total? Calculate: \(25\times4=?\)
You buy 4 pens and 6 pens at 8 yuan each. How many yuan is the total cost? Calculate: \(8\times(4+6)=?\)
Each book costs 48 yuan, and you buy 2 books. You can first calculate \(50\times2\) and then subtract \(2\times2\). What is \(50\times2\)? Calculate: \(50\times2=?\)
Divide 1 meter into 10 equal parts and take 7 parts. How many meters is this, expressed to 1 decimal place? Calculate: \(0.1\times7=?\) (Answer as a decimal.)
Calculate: \(3.5-2.8=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
Calculate: \(1.6-1.2=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
One rope is 2.4 meters long, and another is 1.9 meters long. How many meters longer is the longer rope than the shorter rope? Calculate: \(2.4-1.9=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
Calculate: \(1.2\times10=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
Calculate: \(35\div10=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
What is 100 times 0.8? Calculate: \(0.8\times100=?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
To round 3.8 to the nearest whole number, look at the tenths digit. The tenths digit is 8, so add 1 to the ones digit. What is the ones digit 3 plus 1? Calculate: \(3+1=?\)
When rounding 6.3 to the nearest whole number, the tenths digit is 3, so do not round up. What is the ones digit of the approximate value? Calculate: \(6+0=?\)
To round 2.46 to one decimal place, look at the hundredths digit, 6, and add 1 to the tenths digit. What is the tenths digit 4 plus 1? Calculate: \(4+1=?\)
How does a right angle compare with an acute angle?

choices.A: A right angle is larger than an acute angle
choices.B: A right angle is smaller than an acute angle
choices.C: A right angle and an acute angle are the same size

displayedInputs.question: How does an obtuse angle compare with a right angle?

choices.A: An obtuse angle is larger than a right angle
choices.B: An obtuse angle is smaller than a right angle
choices.C: An obtuse angle is a right angle
